models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: Key sheet "Clave núm. 109" found in the same fonds (DLXXIII.1.28.14-23).
Contemporary pair DLXXIII.2.41.18-41 / 1.29.9-30, key frozen: 1.000 chars / 1.000 words on the held-out part (200 controls <= -0.021 / 0.111).
Three telegrams decoded: 67 words, 64 certain, 3 probable.
Read share recounted over cipher words only, sure words only (README rule of PR #728), per telegram: 24/24, 12/13 (0.923), 28/30 (0.933); two telegrams and the class go read -> read in part.

Floor for short texts (README, 19 Nov 2026: under 40 cipher words, at most 2 holes) applied to the 18 Nov counts: cehm-dlxxiii-2-41-9-41 (12/13), cehm-dlxxiii-2-41-13-41 (28/30) read; class read in part -> read.

outcome.method_basis: The printed key sheet issued to the general is filed with the telegrams; validated on a contemporary cipher / plain-text pair of the same fonds.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Cipher words only, sure words only (18 Nov 2026), per telegram, the plain text <…> left out: 18 Jul 1913 24 of 24; 13 Mar 1914 12 of 13; 18 Mar 1914 28 of 30; 64 of 67 in all (0.955), but two telegrams are under 95%. Before: 67 of 67, probable counted as read. Floor for short texts (README, 19 Nov 2026): cehm-dlxxiii-2-41-9-41 (12/13), cehm-dlxxiii-2-41-13-41 (28/30) under 40 cipher words with at most 2 holes, so read; every document is now read and the class stays read.

texts.label: Lampazos, 18 July 1913, to the Minister of War and Navy (DLXXIII.1.30.16-49, incomplete)
texts.summary: Laredo garrison courted by the Carrancistas; General Treviño at San Antonio in touch with revolutionaries; Téllez should stay at Laredo.

reading_review.note: Read as Spanish sentences and translated: the cipher passages of the three telegrams (67 words) read as coherent sentences with the plain text around them; three probable words only. The scorer's 55% counts the plain-text stretches as holes.

texts.note: 18 Nov 2026, cipher words only, sure words only: 24 of 24 cipher words sure; stays read.
